description: This file is the main module of a Fyne-based GUI application for managing WiFi mesh networks. It defines data structures, creates UI views and tabs, manages periodic updates via a timer, and interfaces with external C code for network operations. The code manages various network components like topology, policies, SSIDs, radios, channels, neighbors, and clients, providing a visual and interactive interface.

classes.name: BaseTab
classes.description: Base structure for network component tabs, holds a network node pointer and a UI object.

classes.name: Topology
classes.description: UI component representing the network topology view.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: UI component for policy management view.

classes.name: SSID
classes.description: UI component for SSID list view.

classes.name: WifiRadio
classes.description: UI component for WiFi radio settings.

classes.name: WifiChannel
classes.description: UI component for WiFi channel settings.

classes.name: ClientDevice
classes.description: UI component for client device connections.

classes.name: WifiNeighbors
classes.description: UI component for WiFi neighbor scanning results.

classes.name: TabInterface
classes.description: Interface defining common behaviors for tab components.

classes.name: EasyMeshView
classes.description: Represents a view in the GUI with associated data and behavior.

classes.name: MeshViewsMgr
classes.description: Manager for the overall GUI application, including views, tabs, and periodic updates.

methods.name: createViews
methods.description: Initializes all views and their corresponding tabs and UI elements.

methods.name: getViewBySelectedTab
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected view based on UI tab selection.

methods.name: timerHandler
methods.description: Handles periodic refreshes of network data by invoking external C functions.
